about_the_game:
Disclaimer: This game is a fictional story set in an alternate universe and is not related to any real-world organizations, companies, individuals, or groups. Please do not associate it with reality. All characters featured in this game are adults.

[Announcement]

*Massage Flirtation King* is set to release a playable demo in October, with the full version launching around Valentine's Day 2026!

[Game Synopsis]

Your college entrance exam scores were disappointing, and you planned to lay low at home for a while. But when you returned, you discovered your parents had fled due to debt, leaving behind only a mortgaged massage parlor.

Unexpectedly, the debt collector turned out to be the former beautiful receptionist of the massage parlor! With her support, you embark on a journey of romance and adventure while paying off your debts!

[Game Features]

- Experience a unique blend of romance and business management from the perspective of a male massage therapist!

- Six female characters with distinct personalities and backgrounds to pursue: a student, a receptionist, a flight attendant, a fitness coach, a housewife, and a businesswoman—each with professional, casual, and massage outfits to cater to all your fantasies!

- Three different endings (Good, Neutral, Bad) for each heroine, totaling over 20 possible game endings!

- Featuring more than 50 stunning high-quality CGs!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10及更新版本
  • Processor: Intel Core2DUO 2GHz以上性能的中央处理器
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 对应DirectX9.0 VRAM128MB以上的显卡
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 支持PCM的声卡

short_description: Along with the heartwarming romance routes of six female characters, it offers a range of fun mini-games. By making strategic management decisions and story choices, you'll unlock your own personalized ending.
